trigger: Siege night 1 (the test). SKIPPED if den_killed or tallmen_killed>=2.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Late February. Minus thirty-four. The lamp line: twelve floodlights on poles around the fence. Galena glows like a ship.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Two a.m. On the far side, by the cooling towers, one lamp goes dark.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [On her feet. Facing the dark lamp. Low, steady growl.]

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: They're testing. One light. To see what we do. Whatever we do, they'll remember it.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The cable's been cut. Not chewed. Cut, at the splice, where it's weakest.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Twenty minutes in the snow with a splice kit and a flashlight in your teeth. Something watches you the whole time.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: At dawn, the lamp's fixed. And there are tracks inside the fence. Just one set. Just looking.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: They don't come in. Not tonight. Tonight was a question.
